verdict.rationale: Pigment documents scheduled imports and native connectors for bringing data into the platform, which covers fresh actuals landing automatically. It also documents variance analysis on the same platform where the budget is built, suggesting actuals flow into the live model rather than a rebuilt one. Nothing explicitly describes the forecast re-baselining or rolling forward on closed-period actuals. Missing for 10: documented actuals-over-forecast replacement or rolling-forecast mechanics after close, evidence that the model updates without rebuild, hands-on or independent corroboration.
